systems.system: Electronic National Population Registration System (eNPRS) / National Identification Card (NID)
systems.tiers: listed in Annex D as a foundational ID system and credential, with no digital ID; the table's rows are misaligned in the text extract, so its attachment to Namibia is read from position and is not certain
